items.question: The absorption tracker will move to an order book rebuilt from a raw feed. A live instrument found half the flow the tracker drops is lost when a watched level falls outside the 10 levels it sees, and a probe measured that a raw top 10 makes that close 2.7 times more frequent. What scope should the switch have?

options.label: (a)
options.text: feed the whole tracker the rebuilt top 10 plus raw trades, exactly as a 24 h probe measured; the deeper ladder becomes a separate later proposal

options.label: (b)
options.text: only the pull/post accumulators come from the raw stream; episodes stay on the 100 ms book; never measured and needs a tracker change

options.label: (c)
options.text: as (a), but hand the tracker every rebuilt level within the proximity plus band distance of the touch (at least 10), measured first by an extra pre-registered arm on the existing 24 h pre-build probe run; fall back to (a) if that arm does not cut the out-of-view closes to 10 % or less

items.rationale: (c) removes the cause in the same build, so the dataset boundary is paid once, and the extra probe arm measures it before any code at almost no cost. (a) ships a known worse defect and pays a second boundary later. (b) is unmeasured.
